prediction_source.label: what the Showdown build predicted for each lineup it chose, handed to the record in process at delivery because a Showdown build has no run folder: the thesis template (or points_max for the baseline and the points-max bank), the realized captain and whether it is a pitcher or a hitter, the team split, the Base sum with the captain at 1.5x and its rank in the build, and the labeled captain-slot and six-slot roster priors or null. build_id is one per build's inputs (date, slate tag, salary and template bytes): the baseline and the ladder of a build share it, and two builds over the same inputs share it too, told apart by their sha256 and recorded_utc.
